# Minimal Colab runtime recipe. The setup cell of every notebook installs only
# the packages from this list whose import fails on the current runtime, so on
# a standard Colab runtime the installation is usually a no-op or a single
# small package. Versions are deliberately unpinned: Colab updates its base
# image, and the tested versions are recorded in data/reference_timings/.
numba
line_profiler
# GPU runtimes only, and only if `import cupy` fails (Colab preinstalls it):
# cupy-cuda12x
